text:
Marie (CSM): Heads up — Albatross (mid-market, 120 seats) usage is down ~42% last 30d and their renewal hits in 28 days. I'm proposing a short 'de-risk corridor' instead of a hard save play: 2-week enablement + temporary downgrade corridor + partner credits. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Rachel (CS Ops): Saw the same signal in the health dashboard. Their onboarding completion rate stalled at 48% after week 2. Link to cohort heatmap: https://go.redwood/albatross-heatmap :eyes:

Jason (AE): I can take an exec touch on Wed 3pm PT. Goal is to reset expectations and buy runway for the enablement. Need concise ROI bullets — any quick numbers on token/cost reduction we can promise if they enable caching/batching?

Devin (SE): Quick note — infra config shows prefix/KV cache turned off in their Dedicated settings. That alone could explain spike and frustration. I can patch a toggle on a canary pool for them and run a 48h trial. Prep checklist below.

Devin (SE): ```
- Canary: enable prefix_cache=true on gpool-12
- Batching: set max_batch_tokens=4096 for chat routes
- Monitor: track 95th pct latency, token spend per session
- Rollback: script `rb_cache_toggle.sh` to revert if regressions
```

Luis (Product): They're also reporting inconsistent reranker outputs since model bump. If we capture 3 failing prompts/examples we can triage model variant vs prompt engineering. Can CS collect those and drop into the shared doc?

Marie (CSM): Creating a short shared plan. Proposal (2-week de-risk corridor):
- Week 0: Exec call + commit to 48h caching trial (Jason/Devin)
- Week 1: Two 30-min 'quick wins' enablement sessions for power users (Devin leads)
- Week 1: Capture 3-5 failing prompts for product investigation (CSM ownership)
- Week 2: Offer 10% credit on overage if they commit to 6-month renewal OR allow a one-month downgrade corridor with preserved data & support (commercial handled by Jason)

Marie (CSM): Owners + rough dates:
- Exec call: Jason (Wed 3pm PT) — prep bullets by Tue EOD
- Canary toggle & metrics: Devin — run 48h test starting Wed 4pm PT
- Enablement sessions: Devin + Rachel — schedule for next Thu/Fri
- Feedback capture (prompts + logs): Marie + customer — collect by next Tue
- Commercial: Jason — draft downgrade corridor language by Tue EOD

Rachel (CS Ops): Tiny ask — can we add a short survey link after enablement asking: "Did the session resolve your primary blockers? (Y/N)" We should capture structured feedback to feed into product triage.

Luis (Product): I'll stand by to review prompts + logs. If we confirm a model regression we can repro on staging and flag for the inference team. Also curious if they saw any latency anomalies tied to specific regions.

Jason (AE): I'll push the credit/downgrade offer but need an 'acceptable usage' baseline to negotiate. Marie — can you pull their last 3 invoices & 30/60/90 usage?

Marie (CSM): On it. Pulling invoices now, will upload to the plan doc. Quick note: prefer to keep this as a 'runway' not a full concession — aim to close as renewal if adoption improves. :rocket:

reminder-bot: Meeting created — "Albatross exec check-in" Wed 3:00 PM PT (calendar invite sent)

Devin (SE): I'll post the trial results to the thread after 48h and include the 95th/median latency and token spend delta. If cache reduces token spend >20% we have a clear commercial argument. :+1:

Marie (CSM): Great. If no blockers, I'll capture this as a lightweight play in the micro-saves folder and mark as 'de-risk-corridor' so we can reuse the template. Thanks team.

Rachel (CS Ops): +1 — will prep the survey and scheduler.

Jason (AE): Thx, team. I'll take the stakeholder list for the exec call and prep the comms.

Marie (CSM): Closing loop — next updates in this thread post-exec call and post-48h trial.
